Abdulaziz Hatem.note: Watch Hatem for organizing the nearby unit before the next phase begins. The clearest example is how he uses short cues to keep nearby passing and pressing options connected. Also watch how Hatem plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Abdulaziz Hatem.noteZh: 观察Abdulaziz Hatem时，可以先看下一阶段开始前组织身边队友。他会用简短提醒让附近的传球与逼抢选择保持连接。另一个比赛细节是他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Ahmed Alaaeldin.note: What separates Alaaeldin is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. Alaaeldin moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. Away from that action, he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ahmed Alaaeldin.noteZh: 理解Ahmed Alaaeldin，要先看防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ahmed Alganehi.summary: Ahmed Al-Ganehi is a Qatari professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Al-Gharafa and the Qatar national team.
Ahmed Alganehi.note: For Al-Ganehi, the foundation is explosive speed once open grass appears. Look first at how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Beyond that, watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Ahmed Alganehi.noteZh: Ahmed Al-Ganehi最鲜明的特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。一个直接线索是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个独立细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Ahmed Fathy.note: The key to Fathy is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. There is another side to his game: he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Ahmed Fathy.noteZh: Ahmed Fathy的比赛建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢之上。首先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个方面是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Akram Afif.note: The key to Afif is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. A separate part of his game is how Afif draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Akram Afif.noteZh: Akram Afif的优势在于比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。最直接的表现是他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个值得观察的细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Alhashmi Alhussein.note: Al-Hussain's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Watch how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. At another point in the move, he steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself.
Alhashmi Alhussein.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢是理解Al-Hashmi Al-Hussain踢法的关键。先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。到了另一个比赛环节，他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。

Almoez Ali.note: Ali's signature is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Watch how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Another detail is how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Almoez Ali.noteZh: Almoez Ali的比赛建立在等防守者注意力转移后再启动之上。首先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个方面是他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Assim Madibo.note: Madibo stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A different detail is how Madibo holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Assim Madibo.noteZh: Assim Madibo最鲜明的特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。一个直接线索是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个独立细节是他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ayoub Aloui.summary: Ayoub Mohamed Aloui is a Qatari defender who plays for Al-Gharafa and has represented Qatar at youth and senior national-team level.
Ayoub Aloui.note: Aloui stands out for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. Also look at how Aloui checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Ayoub Aloui.noteZh: 最能体现Ayoub Aloui特点的是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。除此之外，他也会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Boualem Khoukhi.note: What separates Khoukhi is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Khoukhi holds the route into the box until support arrives. Also note how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Boualem Khoukhi.noteZh: 最能体现Boualem Khoukhi特点的是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。这一点直接体现在他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，他也会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Edmilson Junior.note: For Edmilson, the foundation is explosive speed once open grass appears. Look first at how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Also watch how he plays forward toward an available runner when the opening appears.
Edmilson Junior.noteZh: Edmilson Junior的比赛建立在看到空当后的爆发速度之上。首先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个方面是他会线路出现时向前送给可接应的跑动者。

Hassan Alhaydos.note: What separates Al-Haydos is repeatable technique on dead balls. Al-Haydos varies the height and pace of his delivery. A separate detail appears when he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Hassan Alhaydos.noteZh: 定位球上稳定而多变的脚法是理解Hassan Al-Haydos踢法的关键。先看他如何通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。到了另一个比赛环节，他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Homam Ahmed.note: For Ahmed, the foundation is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Look first at how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Also watch how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Homam Ahmed.noteZh: 观察Homam Ahmed时，可以先看从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个比赛细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Issa Laye.note: Laye's signature is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. Watch how he protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. Another detail is how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Issa Laye.noteZh: 对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择构成Issa Laye踢法的核心。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Jassem Gaber.note: Watch Gaber for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. The clearest example is how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Also notice how Gaber holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Jassem Gaber.noteZh: Jassem Gaber的比赛建立在用传球的力度和角度移动防线之上。首先看他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。另一个方面是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Karim Boudiaf.note: The key to Boudiaf is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. There is another side to his game: he steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself.
Karim Boudiaf.noteZh: 多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构是理解Karim Boudiaf踢法的关键。先看他如何改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。到了另一个比赛环节，他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。

Lucas Mendes.note: For Mendes, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. A separate point is how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Lucas Mendes.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Lucas Mendes踢法的关键。先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Mahmoud Abunada.note: Watch Abunada for command of the crowded space around goal. The clearest example is how he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders. Elsewhere, Abunada sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Mahmoud Abunada.noteZh: Mahmoud Abunada的比赛建立在掌控门前拥挤空间的能力之上。首先看他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。另一个方面是他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Meshaal Barsham.note: What separates Barsham is keeping his body shape compact for reflex saves at close range. Barsham keeps his hands and feet connected so the reflex block stays controlled. In another phase of play, he waits for the strike before committing.
Meshaal Barsham.noteZh: Meshaal Barsham的优势在于近距离反应扑救时保持紧凑身体姿态。最直接的表现是他会让手脚保持联动，使本能挡球也能控制方向。另一个值得观察的细节是他会等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。

Mohamed Manai.note: Manai stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Manai also takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Mohamed Manai.noteZh: 观察Mohamed Manai时，可以先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个比赛细节是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Mohammed Muntari.note: Watch Muntari for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. The clearest example is how he starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball. Also watch how Muntari pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Mohammed Muntari.noteZh: 最能体现Mohammed Muntari特点的是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。这一点直接体现在他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。除此之外，他也会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Pedro Miguel.note: The key to Miguel is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. He gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. In another phase, Miguel meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Pedro Miguel.noteZh: 封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者是理解Pedro Miguel踢法的关键。先看他如何靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。到了另一个比赛环节，他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Salah Zakaria.note: Zakaria's signature is command of the crowded space around goal. Watch how he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders. Away from that moment, he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Salah Zakaria.noteZh: 看Salah Zakaria的作用，关键是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Sultan Albrake.note: Al-Brake stands out for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. A different detail is how Al-Brake gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Sultan Albrake.noteZh: Sultan Al-Brake的优势在于从后场加入进攻的启动时机。最直接的表现是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个值得观察的细节是他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Tahsin Mohammed.note: The key to Jamshid is explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. A separate part of his game is how Jamshid draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Tahsin Mohammed.noteZh: Tahsin Mohammed Jamshid的优势在于看到空当后的爆发速度。最直接的表现是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个值得观察的细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Yusuf Abdurisag.note: Watch Abdurisag for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. The clearest example is how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Also notice how Abdurisag moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Yusuf Abdurisag.noteZh: Yusuf Abdurisag的优势在于带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。最直接的表现是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。另一个值得观察的细节是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。
